<subject>HCSN Symposium Invitation</subject>
<body>
MediCare Alliance

Please find below the official invitation for the HCSN Healthcare Symposium. A printed version will be sent shortly.

Dr. V. Leblanc  
Lumière Santé SAS  
BP 1188  
Villeurbanne, Lyon 69100

MediCare Alliance

11 March 2025

I am pleased to formally invite you to attend, participate, and present at the HCSN Regional Healthcare Symposium. Each invited speaker will have thirty minutes for their presentation, followed by approximately ten minutes for questions and discussion. This symposium, supported by a grant from the European Health Network (EHN) to HCSN, is not a typical healthcare conference with representatives from hospitals, academia, and public health agencies sharing recent research. Instead, the event will focus on the clinical applications and technological advances currently being implemented across healthcare providers and research institutions. Additionally, the symposium aims to highlight the strategies fostering collaboration between hospitals, academic research, and government health bodies.

The event will take place at the Lyon Medical Center, from 25 to 28 April. The French Health Foundation will cover invited speakers’ travel, accommodation, and meal expenses. We are happy to assist with travel arrangements if required.

We hope you will accept this invitation. Should you do so, please provide us with your presentation title, a brief abstract, and any technical requirements needed for your session.

Looking forward to welcoming you at the Lumière Health Network.

Best regards,

Christophe Rivière  
Specialist  
Lumière Santé SAS  
T: +33 4 72 00 11 22  
E: c.riviere@lumieresante.fr  
</body>
